description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) - Curated Financial & Contractual Knowledge Catalog

rules.summary: Sum of itemized goods and services must equal stated subtotal.
rules.guidance: Flag any discrepancy where line item extensions do not reconcile with stated subtotal as an additional charge or math discrepancy.

rules.summary: Applied tax amounts must reconcile with applicable statutory tax rates on taxable subtotals.
rules.guidance: Verify whether taxes match the stated rate. Any unaccounted difference should be marked as requiring verification.

rules.rule_name: Automatic Renewal and Notice Period Requirement
rules.summary: Recurring subscription agreements must explicitly disclose auto-renewal and minimum cancellation notice windows.
rules.source_reference: FTC Negative Option Rule & Consumer Protection Standards
rules.guidance: Identify auto-renewal clauses lacking at least a 30-day prior written notice requirement before billing commitment.

rules.summary: Processing, platform, or administrative surcharges must be itemized before payment commitment.
rules.source_reference: Truth in Lending & Consumer Financial Protection Standards
rules.guidance: Flag any general surcharge, convenience fee, or administrative overhead fee not detailed in original quotation.

rules.summary: Extended warranty coverage often excludes consumable parts, wear-and-tear, or imposes mandatory deductibles.
rules.guidance: Highlight limitations, pre-existing condition exclusions, or required out-of-pocket deductibles prior to commitment.

rules.summary: Commercial service contracts often impose steep liquidated damages or restocking penalties for cancellation.
rules.guidance: Review early termination fees that exceed 20% of remaining agreement balance or restocking fees exceeding 15%.
